hints.title: Bounded Value Frequency Counting
hints.text: Since values range from 0 to 100, aggregate elements into a compact frequency count array.

hints.title: Triplet Case Enumeration
hints.text: Iterate distinct value pairs (i, j) with k = target - i - j, considering cases where i, j, k are all equal, partially equal, or distinct.

hints.title: Combinatorial Selection Multipliers
hints.text: Apply combination formulas nC3 for three identical values, nC2 * m for two identical values, and n * m * p for three distinct values, summing modulo 10^9 + 7.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all index triplets takes O(N^3) time.
